Gurugram Gunfight: Four Gangsters Killed, Police Injured in Shootout

A gun battle occurred in Gurugram's Sushant Lok area, resulting in the deaths of four alleged gangsters and injuries to one. Three police personnel also sustained bullet injuries during the exchange, which involved over 60 rounds fired. One individual, Beri, was safely rescued. The recovered firearms are suspected to be Chinese-made pistols, and police are investigating their supply chain and potential links to organized gangs, including the Deepak Nandal gang.
